# Kyoto Autumn Trip Plan: 4 Days for 2 Adults

A balanced Kyoto plan for **2025-10-12 to 2025-10-15** with temples, food, and one relaxed neighborhood walk each day. Budget is kept within **USD 1,800 excluding flights**, using moderate meals, transit, and mostly low-cost admissions.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan

### Day 1: Higashiyama Welcome Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, then start at **Kiyomizu-dera** for classic Kyoto views.
- Afternoon: Walk through **Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka**, then visit **Yasaka Shrine** and nearby lanes.
- Evening: Dinner in Gion or Higashiyama; keep it simple with tempura, soba, or tofu set meals.
- Low-key neighborhood walk: **Gion side streets at dusk** for a calm first-night stroll.
- Estimated cost for 2: **JPY 18,000–24,000**

### Day 2: Arashiyama Temples and Riverside
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** and **Tenryu-ji** before crowds build.
- Afternoon: Cross **Togetsukyo Bridge**, browse the riverside area, and visit a tea shop or dessert café.
- Evening: Dinner in Arashiyama or back in central Kyoto; try yudofu, grilled fish, or Kyoto-style obanzai.
- Low-key neighborhood walk: **Arashiyama backstreets near the river** and temple approaches.
- Estimated cost for 2: **JPY 16,000–22,000**

### Day 3: Central Kyoto Food and Temple Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Visit **Nijo Castle** or **Nishiki Market** first, depending on whether you want history or food first.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Visit **Nijo Castle** or **Nishiki Market** first, depending on whether you want history or food first, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Explore **Nishiki Market** slowly, then head to **Teramachi / Shinkyogoku** for a casual shopping walk.
- Evening: Dinner around downtown Kyoto with a kaiseki-lite set, ramen, or izakaya plates.
- Low-key neighborhood walk: **Teramachi and Shinkyogoku arcades** for an easy covered stroll.
- Estimated cost for 2: **JPY 20,000–28,000**

### Day 4: Northern Kyoto and Final Slow Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Visit **Kinkaku-ji** early for the best light and lighter crowds.
- Afternoon: Continue to **Ryoan-ji** or **Ninna-ji** for a quieter temple finish.
- Evening: Final dinner in Kyoto station area or downtown; choose a relaxed meal and an early night if departing next day.
- Low-key neighborhood walk: **Quiet streets around Ryoan-ji/Ninna-ji** or a gentle station-area stroll.
- Estimated cost for 2: **JPY 17,000–23,000**

## Budget Check and Daily Rhythm

| Day | Focus | Main Spend Areas | Estimated Cost for 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Higashiyama | Temple entry, local transit, dinner | JPY 18,000–24,000 |
| 2 | Arashiyama | Transit, temple, café stops, dinner | JPY 16,000–22,000 |
| 3 | Central Kyoto | Food market, castle/temple, shopping walk, dinner | JPY 20,000–28,000 |
| 4 | Northern Kyoto | Temple entries, transit, final dinner | JPY 17,000–23,000 |

Total estimated trip spend for 2 adults: **JPY 71,000–97,000**
That is roughly **USD 475–650** at a typical recent exchange range, leaving comfortable room in your **USD 1,800** budget for nicer meals, souvenirs, taxis, or a special dinner.

## Autumn Packing Checklist for Kyoto

- Light jacket or medium-weight layer for cooler mornings and evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes with good grip
- Compact umbrella or rain shell
- 4–5 breathable tops
- 2–3 bottoms you can mix and match
- One warmer layer for night walks
- Socks you can wear all day comfortably
- Reusable water bottle
- Small day bag or sling
- Portable charger
- Tissue pack and hand sanitizer
- Any personal meds and travel documents
- Optional: scarf for chilly evenings in mid-October
